_om: Pyramiden in English (Pyramid, rusj.no/en/pyramid/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The short lines (bluff, water breaks …) are in data.en/tekster.json. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
{til} ropte bløff – men {fra} hadde kort: {til} called bluff – but {fra} had the card. +1 point to {fra}.
{fra} ble tatt i bløff av {til}. +1 poen: {fra} was caught bluffing by {til}. +1 point to {til}.
Nobody has handed anything out yet.
Fire hemmelige kort hver, femten kort i: Four secret cards each, fifteen cards in a pyramid – and a good helping of bluff.
Mobilen går rundt. Hold fingeren på kort: The phone goes round. Hold your finger on the card and remember your four cards – you won't see them again until the finale.
Kortene snus ett og ett nedenfra. Har du: The cards are turned one by one from the bottom. If you have the same value, you hand out sips: 1 on the bottom row, 5 at the top. Each player can hand out once per card.
Den som får slurkene, kan rope bløff – m: Whoever gets the sips can call bluff – the phone knows everything. The loser of the duel takes two extra sips, and the winner gets 1 point. A card shown as proof is swapped for a new secret card.
Du kan bløffe selv om du ikke har kortet: You can bluff even if you don't have the card. Get away with it and you get 1 point – it's only revealed in the results.
Roper du bløff og tar feil, får den andr: Call bluff and get it wrong, and the other player gets the point. Think carefully!
Aldri mer enn 5 slurker om gangen, og in: Never more than 5 sips at a time, and nobody can be given sips by more than two players on the same card.
Små slurker. Vann, brus og alkoholfritt: Small sips. Water, soft drinks and alcohol-free count just as much, and anyone can sit out.
Før rad 3 og før toppkortet er det vannp: Before row 3 and before the top card, everyone has a water break.
«Hvem ga hva» viser alt som har skjedd,: ‘Who gave what’ shows everything that has happened, and ‘Undo’ takes back the last hand-out.
I finalen sier alle kortene sine høyt. H: In the finale everyone says their cards out loud. Every card you've forgotten is 1 sip.
Four secret cards. Fifteen in the pyramid.
Bløff deg gjennom pyramiden!: Bluff your way through the pyramid!
Med åtte eller flere bruker vi to kortst: With eight or more players we use two decks.
Alle trenger et navn – mobilen holder st: Everyone needs a name – the phone keeps track of who has which cards.
Til slutt sier alle kortene sine høyt. H: At the end everyone says their cards out loud. Every forgotten card is 1 sip.
Små slurker. Vann, brus og alkoholfritt: Small sips. Water, soft drinks and alcohol-free count just as much – and anyone can sit out.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se kortene: Hold your finger on the card to see {navn}'s cards
Husket alle fire? Trykk «Ferdig» og gi m: Remembered all four? Tap ‘Done’ and pass the phone on.
Alle har sett – til pyramiden!: Everyone has looked – on to the pyramid!
Kortene snus ett og ett, nederste rad fø: The cards are turned one by one, bottom row first. Got the same value in your hand? Hand out sips! Or bluff.
Everyone has handed out on this card.

{n} av {alle} har delt ut på dette korte.one: {n} of {alle} has handed out on this card.
{n} av {alle} har delt ut på dette korte.other: {n} of {alle} have handed out on this card.

{navn} har delt ut på dette kortet. Én g: {navn} already handed out on this card. Once each!
{navn} har fått slurker to ganger på det: {navn} already got sips twice on this card. Pick someone else!
Mobilen sjekker kortene. Taperen tar {sl: The phone checks the cards. The loser takes {slurker}, and the winner gets 1 point.
{navn} står over – helt greit. Ingen slu: {navn} sits this one out – that's fine. No sips this time.
Kortet er brukt. {navn} får et nytt hemm: That card is used up. {navn} gets a new secret card.
{navn} har ingen {kort} og tar {slurker}: {navn} has no {kort} and takes {slurker} as a penalty.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se det nye: Hold your finger on the card to see {navn}'s new card
Husket det? Kortet du viste fram, er ute: Got it? The card you showed is out of the game.
Bare {navn} skal se. Kortet som ble vist: Only {navn} should look. The card that was shown has been swapped.
Si alle fire kortene høyt – så snur vi d: Say all four cards out loud – then we'll turn them over. Every forgotten card is 1 sip.
Bløffet {ganger} uten å bli tatt. Nå vet: Bluffed {ganger} without being caught. Now you know!
Ingen slapp unna med en bløff i kveld. F: Nobody got away with a bluff tonight. What an honest crew!
Ble kalt bløffmaker {ganger} – og hadde: Was called a bluffer {ganger} – and had the card.
Remembered all four of their cards.
Ingen bløffet seg unna, og ingen ropte b: Nobody bluffed their way out, and nobody called bluff. What an honest crew!
1 poeng for hver bløff som slapp unna, h: 1 point for every bluff that got away, every bluff you caught, and every time you were wrongly called a bluffer.
Drikk et glass vann før neste spill!: Have a glass of water before the next game!
{fra} hadde kortet. {til} tar {slurker},: {fra} had the card. {til} takes {slurker}, and {fra} gets 1 point and a new secret card.
Angret – utdelingen er tatt bort: Undone – the hand-out has been removed
Dere går rett til kåringen med stillinge: You go straight to the results with the scores so far.
